definition.mode: offline fixed-threshold semantic-cache replay with complete test-only RQ3 pair ground truth
definition.workload_universe: all unique queries in the held-out test split: anchors plus positive and negative candidates
definition.stream_order: seeded random permutation of the global unique test-query set
definition.semantic_selection: nearest query currently in cache by cosine similarity
definition.threshold_mode: fixed a priori; no validation calibration
definition.ground_truth_source: complete test-only RQ3 pair file generated by executing every unique test query once and evaluating every unordered pair

ground_truth_labels.excluded_middle: pair absent from both lists; complete pair accounting guarantees 0.1 < J < 0.8
ground_truth_labels.unknown: none: complete RQ3 pair accounting eliminates unannotated pairs

definition.runtime_state_rule: offline RQ3 labels never alter cache state: every cosine-accepted pair is reused and the incoming query is not inserted
definition.result_ground_truth_usage: RQ3 Jaccard-derived labels are used only after runtime selection for offline evaluation and by the non-deployable oracle baseline
definition.validation_usage: none for RQ3; threshold is fixed a priori

validation.note: RQ3 uses test-only complete pair ground truth and a fixed a-priori cosine threshold; validation replay is intentionally not performed.
